_readme: Every scheduled job for the knowledge graph, monitors, quality control and finance. Placeholders: {POTTER_HOME} {WS} {TZ} {TO} {OC} {KG_DB}. standby=true: created switched off and listed for handover (it messages the owner, acts on a shared account, or needs configuration first). Schedules and time zones follow the previous assistant's jobs.

jobs.name: potter-kg-curate
jobs.purpose: knowledge graph clean-up (deterministic part; model decisions once a model policy is set)

jobs.name: potter-qc-recorder
jobs.purpose: records yesterday's claims of finished work

jobs.name: potter-qc-verifier
jobs.purpose: checks those claims and every schedule; one message only when something does not hold up

jobs.name: potter-qc-recheck
jobs.purpose: closes open QC items once the evidence appears

jobs.name: potter-fetch-city-events
jobs.purpose: fetches city event listings (needs the monitor config)

jobs.name: potter-fetch-local
jobs.purpose: fetches local news and businesses (needs the monitor config)

jobs.name: potter-fetch-wine
jobs.purpose: fetches wine prices (needs the monitor config)

jobs.name: potter-fetch-feeds
jobs.purpose: fetches financial deal feeds (needs the monitor config)

jobs.name: potter-weekend-digest
jobs.message: Run the events-digest skill for the weekend preview. Reply with the digest only, or nothing.

jobs.name: potter-local-monitor
jobs.message: Run the local-monitor skill. Reply with the update only, or nothing.

jobs.name: potter-wine-watch
jobs.message: Run the wine-watch skill. Reply only if a price is worth acting on.

jobs.name: potter-reply-monitor
jobs.message: Run the reply-monitor skill. Reply only if an awaited reply arrived.
jobs.purpose: watches for an awaited email reply

jobs.name: potter-financial-scan
jobs.message: Run the financial-scan skill. Output nothing.
jobs.purpose: daily deals scan (silent, feeds the Tuesday digest)

jobs.name: potter-financial-digest
jobs.message: Run the financial-digest skill. Reply with the digest only, or nothing.

jobs.name: potter-weekly-business-brief
jobs.message: Run the weekly-business-brief skill. Reply with the brief only.

jobs.name: potter-kg-progress-gate
jobs.message: Run the kg-progress-gate skill. Reply only if a decision is needed.

jobs.name: potter-workspace-health
jobs.message: Run the workspace-health-check skill. Reply with findings only, or nothing.

jobs.name: potter-daily-trading
jobs.message: Run the trading-run skill. The gate is: python3 {POTTER_HOME}/tools/trading_precheck.py check --mandate trading/MANDATE.md --kill-switch trading/STOP --log trading/logs/trading-run.jsonl --record (run from your workspace). If it refuses, send the one-line refusal and stop.
jobs.purpose: the trading loop under its written mandate

jobs.name: potter-llm-monthly-status
jobs.message: Report the monthly model-scoring status from trading/monthly-scoring. Reply with the status only.
jobs.purpose: monthly scoring status (off in the old assistant too)
